defect.reported: Add adaptation for a model that has no reasoning effort: forcing one onto a model that supports none fails the call.
defect.rootCause: A `teamModels` slot is read MATERIALISED over its schema defaults (`TEAM_MODEL_SLOT_DEFAULTS` states an effort for every slot: slot1 `max`, slot2/3/4 `high`), so a workspace that changed only a slot's provider/model still carried an effort. BOTH runtime carriers of that effort passed it unconditionally: `mpd_role_spawn` (`agentOptions.reasoningEffort`) and the `mpd-roster` provider's delegating `start()` (`applyRoute`). Handing that keyword to a model whose live catalog entry declares NO reasoning efforts (`efforts: []`) is a value no provider can accept, and the call failed.
measuredEvidence: the forced-keyword line the one-shot path carried: packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts — "The slot's OWN effort keyword rides along when it states one"

the surface that ALREADY adapted, proving the capability data exists: the two settings front doors derive a slot's effort options from the SELECTED model's own efforts (packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/settings.ts and packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/src/settings-card.ts, documented in packages/mpd-config-plugin/README.md: 'Their option lists come from the live model catalog') — the runtime was the only surface still forcing a value the model never offered
the catalog contract the fix reads: `DshAdapter.llmCatalog()` projects `efforts` ALWAYS as an array, `[]` for a model with no reasoning block (packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts)
fix: NEW, exported from packages/mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin/src/index.ts: `DshEffortRoute` (the three route fields), the PURE predicate `modelDeclaresNoEffort(catalog, provider, model)` (true only when the catalog lists BOTH the provider and the model with an EMPTY efforts array), and the async, never-throwing `withSupportedEffort(dsh, route)` — it returns the route BY IDENTITY when nothing is adapted, and a NEW copy without `reasoningEffort` when the model declares none, logging the drop.
packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts (mpd_role_spawn): `const slotRoute = await withSupportedEffort(dsh, configuredRoute)` before the spawn's `agentOptions` are built.

packages/mpd-roster-provider-plugin/src/index.ts: `start()` is now async and passes the resolved slot route through `withSupportedEffort` before `applyRoute`, so a routed official `spawn_teammate` is covered too.

bounds.unsupported-but-declared-effort: DELIBERATELY UNCHANGED: a model that DECLARES efforts but not the requested one still receives that keyword and the call still fails visibly. That is a configuration error, and the slot contract forbids substituting or clamping an effort (the settings front doors only offer a model's own efforts, so reaching this state means the config is stale).
bounds.no-knowledge-keeps-the-effort: An unknown model, a composition without the `llmCatalog` seam, and a catalog read that rejects all keep the keyword: 'not listed' is not 'declares none'. The helper also never throws.
bounds.cost: One extra async catalog read per effort-carrying spawn, and ONLY when the route states an effort (the adapter's catalog read iterates the live provider/model list). Nothing is cached, so a model-capability change needs no restart.
bounds.coverage: The adaptation covers the two mpd surfaces that SET an effort. The team-core native executor forwards `request.agentOptions` verbatim and no mpd surface puts an effort there today; a future `spawnAgent` caller that adds one would need the same call. The single choke point `spawnAgent` was deliberately left a pure forwarder so the decision stays visible at each caller.
